description: After the refactor, add a spec asserting the public API surface still exists and behaves as expected: Fetcher::CrestHttpClient.new(cfg, validator), #head/#get, .build_headers, .with_cache, .clear_rate_limiters, .clear_dns_cache (class+instance), .clear_expired_dns, .dns_max_entries / dns_max_entries=, ::REDIRECT_STATUS_CODES, ::DNS_EVICTION_BUFFER. This guards against accidental breakage of the library contract.
title: Add public-API regression test for CrestHttpClient
